reasons: Site evidence contradicts the borrower's claim or the approved plan; no release until the discrepancy is explained. See the inspection notes.
Cost-to-complete gap is negative (₹-1,489,999): remaining funds will not finish the build at expected cost — owner should re-scope now.

explanation.owner_view:
Your construction loan review for loan 1009 (Bachupally, Hyderabad, 2,450 sqft) has identified a few critical items that need attention before further funds can be disbursed. First, while the tranche claim was submitted for the 'brickwork & roof' stage, the photographic evidence confirms the site is currently at the roof slab formwork/shuttering and curing stage (approx. 50% completion), with no exterior brickwork or framed wall openings yet constructed. Second, our cost analysis indicates an estimated total construction cost of ₹44,04,275.19 against your sanctioned loan of ₹32,00,000, leaving a sanction gap of ₹-12,04,275.19. With ₹24,87,861 already disbursed and the remaining cost to complete estimated at ₹22,02,138, there is a cost-to-complete funding gap of ₹-14,89,999. This means remaining sanctioned loan funds will not be sufficient to finish construction without securing additional owner equity or re-scoping the project. Additionally, your contractor's BOQ totals ₹32,52,113 (fair benchmark price of ₹31,71,513.60) and contains several items to clarify:
- Rate Outlier: Could you please clarify the basis for the external plastering rate of Rs 293/sqm compared to the standard benchmark rate of Rs 240/sqm?
- Specifications & Unbenchmarked Items: Could you provide a detailed specification and breakdown of make and materials included in the per-point electrical wiring rate? Could you please share the detailed bill of materials and brand specifications covered under the concealed plumbing set rate? Could you confirm the chemical specification, concentration, and application method included for anti-termite treatment? Could you please specify which approved primary steel brands will be supplied for the TMT reinforcement? Could you confirm the make, dimensions, and basic price allowance per sqft for the vitrified floor tiles? Could you please clarify the brand and product line to be used for internal acrylic emulsion paint?
- Structural & Terms: Could you confirm whether the structural design and drawings require approximately 78.2 kg of steel per cubic metre of RCC for the superstructure and plinth? Would it be possible to realign the payment milestones so that cumulative disbursement before roof slab casting remains closer to 30% in line with work progress (currently 52%)? Could you please confirm in writing whether the quoted rates and total contract amount are inclusive of GST?

Next Steps: Please discuss the stage discrepancy and BOQ clarifications with your contractor, and arrange a financing plan to cover the ₹-14,89,999 funding gap so the project can proceed smoothly.
explanation.officer_view:
TRANCHE APPRAISAL & RISK ASSESSMENT: LOAN 1009
- Sanctioned Amount: INR 32,00,000.00
- Cumulative Disbursed: INR 24,87,861.00
- Expected Total Construction Cost: INR 44,04,275.19 (Value Basis: Bachupally median, 85 listings)
- Completed Value Estimate: INR 88,32,510.64
- Verified Value at Site: INR 22,02,138.00 (50.0% completion)
- Cost to Complete: INR 22,02,138.00
- Cost-to-Complete Gap: INR -14,89,999.00
- Sanction Gap: INR -12,04,275.19
- Exposure Ratio: 1.13 | Projected Exposure Ratio: 1.13
- Live LTV: 28.2% | LTV Default Prior: 0.139
- Recommendation: ESCALATE (Disbursal Hold)

EVIDENCE & RISK FINDINGS:
1. Stage Inconsistency: Borrower claimed 'brickwork_roof'. Visual inspection confirms observed stage is 'slab' formwork/shuttering with reinforcement and curing underway; exterior brickwork, framed openings, and structure enclosures are not visible (matches_claim: false, confidence: high, needs_human_review: true).
2. Critical Over-Disbursal / Exposure Deficit: Cumulative disbursal of INR 24,87,861 exceeds the verified site progress value of INR 22,02,138. The exposure ratio is 1.13, and cost-to-complete gap is negative (INR -14,89,999), creating severe project stall risk unless alternative equity is verified.
3. BOQ & Benchmark Deviations (Provisional Hyderabad benchmark table; CPWD DSR verification pending):
   - BOQ Total: INR 32,52,113.00 vs Fair Price for Quoted Scope: INR 31,71,513.60 (Missing scope value: INR 0.00).
   - Rate Outlier: Item 14 (External plaster 18mm) quoted at INR 293/sqm vs benchmark INR 240/sqm (+22.1% deviation).
   - Unbenchmarked Items: Item 18 (Electrical wiring, INR 642/pt), Item 19 (Plumbing lines, INR 11,719/set), Item 20 (Anti-termite treatment, INR 3,117/sqm).
   - Underspecified Scope: Item 10 (TMT Fe 500 missing primary manufacturer make), Item 15 (Vitrified tiles missing dimensions/brand/price allowance), Item 21 (Interior emulsion missing product tier/brand).
   - Structural Metric Flag: Steel-to-RCC ratio is 78.2 kg/cum (6,913.6 kg steel across 88.4 cum RCC), below standard 80–120 kg/cum residential range.
   - Commercial Terms Risk: Front-loaded milestone schedule requires 52.0% disbursement prior to roof slab casting (max reasonable threshold: 30.0%); BOQ is GST silent.
